stories.title: Trump touts Philippines and Thailand trade deals in first presser since Putin-Xi summit
stories.summary: President Donald Trump held his first news conference since returning from Asia, touting new trade agreements with the Philippines and Thailand and saying around 10 more deals could be announced soon. It was his first extended session with reporters since Thursday's unprecedented three-way meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen.

stories.title: EU and UK agree 'reset' deal at second post-Brexit summit in Brussels
stories.summary: European Council President António Costa, Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham met in Brussels today and adopted a joint statement, with the UK Treasury estimating the deal is worth about £17 billion (0.5% of GDP). It includes easier EU travel and work rights for Britons under 31, a linked carbon market and lower food-export costs, with an implementation Bill due in Parliament next week.

stories.title: Anthropic employee's claimed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis blows up online
stories.summary: A researcher at AI lab Anthropic has posted what they describe as a general proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, one of math's most famous unsolved problems. The claim rocketed to the top of Hacker News with more than 800 points in roughly an hour, though it has yet to be publicly vetted by mathematicians.

stories.title: Ex-Alibaba AI chief's startup doubles valuation to $5B in three months
stories.summary: Pragmatik Labs, the Shanghai AI-agent startup founded by Junyang Lin after he left Alibaba's Qwen team, closed new funding at a $5 billion valuation, up from $2B in August, with investors including CDH Investments and Geely's parent, per Bloomberg. The speed of the jump shows how hot China's crowded AI-agent market has become.

stories.title: YouTube nears $3B settlement with US school districts over addiction claims
stories.summary: YouTube has reached an agreement in principle to pay roughly $3 billion to thousands of US school districts that accused it of designing an addictive platform that harmed students' mental health, sources told Reuters. A final deal could still be months away, but it would be the first big financial reckoning for social media's classroom harms.

stories.title: Browns defense earns its bye-week grades: new faces, similar results
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature's bye-week report card finds a defense that lost Myles Garrett and coordinator Jim Schwartz but still thrives, with Denzel Ward playing at an All-Pro level and Carson Schwesinger emerging as a top-10 linebacker. The run defense is the main thing to fix before the flexed Sunday-night date with the Raiders in Week 12.

stories.title: Friday Skull Session: Buckeyes prep for Nebraska with CFP hopes on the line
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors' Friday Skull Session sets up No. 14 Ohio State's trip to Nebraska, where the 6-4 Cornhuskers field the nation's No. 1 third-down defense and DC Rob Aurich calls Jeremiah Smith 'the LeBron James of college football receivers.' The Buckeyes (7-3) likely need to win out, starting with Saturday's noon game on FOX, to stay in the College Football Playoff race.

stories.title: F1 agrees to return to V8 turbo engines from 2030
stories.summary: The FIA, F1's commercial arm, the teams and every power-unit maker unanimously agreed on a framework to replace today's complex V6 hybrids with lighter, cheaper 2.1-litre turbocharged V8s running on sustainable fuels from 2030. Final rules go to the World Motor Sport Council in Shanghai next month, in the sport's biggest engine shake-up announced ahead of this weekend's Las Vegas GP.

stories.title: DICK'S Sporting Goods cuts the ribbon on remodeled Dublin store
stories.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods opens its remodeled Dublin store at 6111 Sawmill Road today with a three-day grand-opening bash featuring mystery gift cards for the first 100 adults daily, a golf hitting bay and a House of Cleats. Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion signs autographs Sunday from noon to 1:30, with wristbands handed out from 9 a.m.

stories.title: Man accused of killing Columbus journalist Emily Foster finally arraigned
stories.summary: Michael Brooks, accused of stabbing longtime journalist and former Ohio State communications leader Emily Foster to death in her University District home in September 2023, is being arraigned on a murder charge Friday, more than three years after the killing. Brooks had been released from jail just a day before Foster's death and fled to Georgia, where a homeowner captured him during a burglary attempt.

stories.title: Crew open playoff run Saturday at Messi's Inter Miami
stories.summary: Axios Columbus previews the Crew's MLS Cup playoff opener: a best-of-three series at defending champion Inter Miami beginning Saturday at 6 p.m. on Apple TV, with Game 2 next Friday in Columbus. Columbus rides a season-ending six-game winning streak against a Miami side that won just five of its final 17 regular-season matches, though sportsbooks still make Messi's team the heavy favorite.

stories.title: Columbus weather: sunny, mild weekend before a Sunday-night cold front
stories.summary: Central Ohio gets a mostly sunny, mild stretch through the weekend with highs in the mid-60s before a cold front brings light rain Sunday night and a much cooler week with highs in the 40s. Forecasters are also watching a midweek system that could bring rain or snow showers Wednesday night into Thanksgiving.
